feeds.title: Kindermusik
feeds.description: Kindermusik is the world's leading music & movement program for children newborn to 7 and is enjoyed by millions of families around the world. They strive to provide a musical and learning-rich environment for children, help develop the bond between the parent and child, and support their amazing network of Kindermusik educators. Follow this blog for music reviews, parenting tips, early education research, fun activities, inspiration, interviews, and so much more.

feeds.title: Go Kid Music Blog
feeds.description: Go Kid Music is a ground-breaking production company specializing in children's music. They write songs for school topics and produce digital song packs for primary school (first grade) teachers and preschools (kindergarten). Here you'll find loads of exciting musical video content, shows, events, announcements, press, children's songs and more.

feeds.title: Buy Nursery Rhymes For Youtube
feeds.description: Welcome To My Pretty Little Blog!! Producer/Lyricist/Vocalist For Nursery Rhymes.Please Write Me Before Ordering to You maybe a You-tuber, teacher, parent or a reseller.No matter what, if you like my samples I can work with you from today.I do nursery rhymes mainly as my hobby, but I can do anything music related for you.

feeds.title: Sing to Kids Blog
feeds.description: Singtokids is an early childhood and elementary music resource page. Follow this blog to find some inspirations and lessons 'with a twist' to ignite your teaching!

feeds.title: Monkey Music Blog
feeds.description: Monkey Music introduces music to very young children in a way they easily understand and enjoy. Follow this blog for unique and progressive learning articles for your child, which includes over 500 original songs and musical activities.

feeds.title: Musication Blog
feeds.description: Musication provides music lessons and camps to children ages 2 and up, in which students learn about music through hands on instrument playing, listening, singing, and exploring.

feeds.title: Boogie Mites
feeds.description: We use original music that is enjoyed as much by adults as by children to ensure that the adults taking part are enthusiastic and uplifted. We use home-made props and instruments to promote recycling and to ensure that the cost of expensive instruments is not a barrier. Our programmes have been developed over many years, with input from practitioners, parents, children, early years advisors and musicians, and are evidence based by a Chichester University Evaluation Study.

feeds.title: Kids Music By Marcie
feeds.description: This blog offers an exceptional selection of great music for children that is both educational and entertaining. Follow for all the latest news about upcoming eBooks, performances, and more!

feeds.title: Benny Time
feeds.description: Benny is equal part's singer, songwriter, performer, early childhood educator & a proud Dad too. Through his music, both recorded & live, Benny is all about creating an environment for kids to simply have fun. Through his blog he'll be sharing exclusive content - podcasts with influential community figures, kids music & book reviews, funny videos, guitar lessons and more.

feeds.title: Zooglobble
feeds.description: Kids music blog with news, reviews, videos, interviews, mp3s, and more.

feeds.title: Nancy Kopman Blog
feeds.description: Nancy Kopman is a teacher, songwriter, recording artist and performer. Her songs are useful and fun for babies to 10-year-olds. Her music introduces babies and toddlers to important early childhood concepts, language cues and skills, and her songs for older children help them memorize important information, like the planets, continents, oceans, provinces, vowels and much more!

feeds.title: Rocking Dan Teaching Man
feeds.description: Dan Colquhoun enjoy collaborating with the children. He teaches to write songs about the things they are learning in class. He record the songs and make animations to go along with them. His blog promotes and provides background for his fun and scholastic songs that are designed to help children succeed in the classroom, covering topics like basic math skills, the alphabets and Literacy.

feeds.title: Daddy Donut
feeds.description: Daddy Donut is a Swedish musician who produces fantastic music and videos for children, all central to the topic of dinosaurs. On this blog you will find posts introducing each of his dinosaur songs and videos, complete with fun and interesting facts about different dinosaurs. Also, kids will learn all about dinosaurs from this unique children's music, which includes songs about the T-Rex, Triceratops, Brontosaurus, and more.

feeds.title: Listen & Learn Music - Helping children grow and thrive through music Blog
feeds.description: Listen & Learn Music is the home of over 200 music therapy songs and early childhood music resources by board-certified music therapist Rachel Rambach. Here she shares her original songs and thoughts on music therapy, motherhood, and business ownership.

feeds.title: My Little Conservatory Blog
feeds.description: My Little Conservatory shares the joy of music with young children. They offer Kindermusik and Music for Little Mozarts (private piano). You'll find posts on music for kids, parenting, fun things to do in Silicon Valley, general music, piano and of course, Kindermusik!

feeds.title: Teddies Music Club
feeds.description: Teddies Music Club is a place for you and your children to sing, learn, and above all, have fun. Follow this blog to entertain and educate your children with hundreds of wonderful, funny action songs, rhymes, story songs more.

feeds.title: Jennifer Ellis Music Blog
feeds.description: Jennifer's music is a brilliant combination of great rhythms, unforgettable lyrics and an amazing voice. She brings her original songs as well as her passion for the Great American Songbook to audiences of all ages. Follow for more videos & live performances.
